# The Leech lattice, glued from the Golay Construction B lattice along the order-two subgroup generated by the odd shift `(-3/2, 1/2, …, 1/2)`

Its carrier is the union of the
Construction B lattice and its translate by the shift, by `mem_leechLattice_carrier_iff`.

```lean
TauCeti.leechLattice : TauCeti.IntegralLattice (Fin 24 → ℚ)
```
